pages.text: Maxwell's equations put electricity, magnetism and light into one theory: changing fields make each other, and a wave of field carries itself across empty space at $(thing)c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀)$().

The $(item)Laser Cutter$() cuts copper into $(item)Waveguides$() (microwaves along a pipe), $(item)Bitter Plates$() and $(item)Rail Armatures$(). A $(item)Faraday Cage Mesh$() keeps fields out - carried in the off hand it shields you from Decoherence. $(item)Mu-Metal$(), nickel-iron so permeable the field runs through it instead of you, does the same for being Magnetized.
$(item)Litz Wire$(), woven so every strand takes its turn at the surface, winds the coils of the Tokamak.
